description: Schema of the binary descriptor (spec 16.41): what an lw binary implements, as `lw version --json` prints it and each release publishes it (lw-<version>-descriptor.json, listed in the signed SHA256SUMS). The binary half of Root.describe (19.20): the same binary, transport and objects shapes, without a session. Fields are only ever added; a reader ignores a field it does not know.

schemas.description: The working-copy (user) and cache schema versions this binary reads and writes (19.9).

objects.description: The core objects a daemon of this binary mounts, each interface with its versions and the sha256 of each version's schema document. Interfaces a module mounts depend on the workspace and are not listed.
